shared_elements: shallow incised linear detailing on the stone surface
stylised facial features (eyes, nose, mouth) rendered in relief
arms or limbs indicated as raised relief bands across the body
museum lighting on unpainted grey-brown stone
justification: Both are massive stone anthropomorphic sculptures whose surfaces carry shallow incised detail, including a distinctive cross-hatched grid area and relief bands reading as arms laid across the body, and both show the same reduction of a face to a few broad planes. The decisive differences are viewpoint and scale of framing — A is a whole frontal slab-like monolith with a vertically stacked scheme of headdress, chest disc and lower band, while B is a tight three-quarter/profile close-up of a head and shoulders in the round, so no comparable overall composition can be verified.
